source: BMR, "PLA34 Modbus registers", version 1.6, firmware 2.0.54 and newer
notes: BMR PLA34, firmware 2.0.54 and newer. The device reads with FC03 and writes with FC16.
Addresses are written as in the manual, from 0. The manual does not list the RS485 defaults.
Harmonics are given twice: in volts, amperes, watts or vars from 20000, and in percent from 40481.
Energy counters are int64 in tenths of kWh or kvarh (55000-55023), and repeated as float32 (55024-55035).
The manual does not say from when the times of the maximums and minimums are counted.
